_comment: Extra build_geometry.py flags per plan version. The ONE source for both the manual build (build_version.py) and Edit AI's rebuild (edit_ai.py VERSIONS). Change a version's flags here only, then rebuild with: ~/.dwg-tools/bin/python build_version.py <version>. kareems-changes' last --cut carves off the 0.32 m block build_geometry's corner-square step adds to the reception column (DWG face x 207.9471 = plan 17.542); without it the column re-inflates to 17.862 (Edit AI 0a5a7de, 25 Oct 2026). Locked by design-locks.json kc-column-face. karims-version (Karim's version, split from Main 26 Oct 2026) has the same flags, and so does naghams-changes since 28 Oct 2026 (its deployed model is a copy of Main's, built with the cut; a Move or Edit AI rebuild without it re-inflated the column: e2e J142). Locked by kv-column-face / ng-column-face. kareems-changes' first --cut is the master-shower niche: 0.70 wide centred on the 0.785 shower, 0.15 deep from the partition's shower face (y -114.1531) plus 2 cm into the shower (31 Oct 2026: shower 1.35, partition 22.5, vanity 1.10, WC bay 0.83).
